title: She froze at the interview door... then he showed up
caption:
Interview nerves got her frozen at the door
Shaking outside the room with her folder hugged tight, she gets a gentle head pat from him - then walks in glowing and tells the whole panel she is ready to give her best.
The right words from the right person can turn pure fear into courage.
Who is the one person that always steadies your nerves?
Share this with them and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more little stories.
